The '''2025–26 Thai FA Cup''' is the 32nd season of [[Thai FA Cup]], [[Thailand]]'s top knockout [[Association football|football]] competition. Officially named the '''Chang FA Cup''' ({{langx|th|ช้าง เอฟเอคัพ}}) due to sponsorship from [[ThaiBev|Chang]], the tournament is organized by the [[Football Association of Thailand]] and open to clubs across all divisions. 95 clubs entered the competition, which began with the qualification round on 24 September 2025 and will conclude with the final on 31 May 2026.

Clubs from [[Thai League 2]], [[Thai League 3]], the [[Thailand Semi-pro League]], and the [[Thailand Amateur League]] compete in the qualification round, with some clubs receiving byes to the first round, which features 64 teams. [[Thai League 1]] clubs automatically enter at this round. Matches in the qualification round proceed to penalties if tied after 90 minutes, while from the first round onward, extra time and penalties are used to determine the winner. All rounds are single-elimination, with home advantage determined by draw, except for the semifinals and final, which are held at neutral venues.

The tournament winner will earn a spot in the [[2026–27 AFC Champions League Elite]] League stage and the [[Thailand Champions Cup|2026 Thailand Champions Cup]]. The champion will also receive a prize of 5,000,000 [[Thai baht|baht]], while the runner-up will be awarded 1,000,000 baht. As one of the most prestigious competitions in Thai football, the FA Cup offers clubs from all tiers a chance to compete for national honors.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://mgronline.com/cyberbiz/detail/9680000090894 |title=AIS จัดเต็มถ่ายทอดสด ช้าง เอฟเอคัพ ตั้งแต่รอบคัดเลือกจนถึงรอบชิงฯ (in Thai). |work=mgronline.com |date=23 September 2025}}</ref>

===Qualification round===
The qualification round of the 2025–26 Thai FA Cup featured 62 clubs, comprising 10 clubs from [[2025–26 Thai League 2]], 33 clubs from [[2025–26 Thai League 3]], 7 clubs from [[Thailand Semi-pro League]], and 12 clubs from the [[Thailand Amateur League]]. The draw for this round took place on 29 August 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-fa-cup/88993/ |title=จับสลากช้าง เอฟเอ คัพ 2025/26 รอบคัดเลือก แข่ง 24 ก.ย. (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=29 August 2025}}</ref> 114 goals were scored in this round.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thairath.co.th/sport/thaifootball/thaipremierleague/2884957 |title=นครปฐม ซิตี้ โพสต์ถึง สมุย ยูไนเต็ด หลังโดนถล่ม 20-0 ตกรอบ ช้าง เอฟเอคัพ (in Thai). |work=thairath.co.th |date=25 September 2025}}</ref>

===First round===
The first round consists of 64 clubs: 31 winners from the qualification round and 33 clubs that automatically advanced. Among the qualification round winners are 5 clubs from T2, 22 from T3, 1 from TS, and 3 from TA. Joining them are 16 clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 1]], who were granted automatic entry as the top-tier league representatives. Additionally, clubs from other leagues received byes directly to the first round, including 4 clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 2]], 6 clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 3]], 3 clubs from the [[Thailand Semi-pro League]], and 4 clubs from the [[Thailand Amateur League]]. The draw for this round took place on 2 October 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-fa-cup/91402/ |title=บุรีรัมย์ ชน วารินฯ, เมืองทอง ดวล ร่มเกล้า จับสลากช้างเอฟเอคัพ รอบ 64 ทีม (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=2 October 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.pptvhd36.com/sport/news/258332 |title=ผลประกบคู่บอลช้าง เอฟเอ คัพ รอบ 64 ทีม บุรีรัมย์-บีจี-ท่าเรือ ไม่หนัก (in Thai). |work=pptvhd36.com |date=2 October 2025}}</ref> 141 goals were scored in this round.

===Second round===
The second round consists of 32 clubs, all securing victories in the first round. This stage features 15 clubs from the T1, 6 clubs from the T2, 9 clubs from the T3, and 2 clubs from the TA. The draw for this round took place on 20 November 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-fa-cup/94581/ |title=เมืองทอง ฟัด ลำพูน,ท่าเรือ ดวล บียู จับสลากช้างเอฟเอคัพ 32 ทีม (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=20 November 2025}}</ref> 54 goals were scored in this round.

===Third round===
The third round consists of 16 clubs, all securing victories in the second round. This stage features 10 clubs from the T1, 4 clubs from the T2, and 2 clubs from the T3.
